_comment: M7-21 retune for the INFORMED thief. M7-16 evolved this vector under a HIDDEN feed; M7-18 then taught the thief to read the opponent cop's capture claims, so its weights were tuned for a blinder agent than it now is. Pool is a MIXTURE of information worlds, because we do not choose which cop we draw: two loud cops we can read (claim_feed truth), one QUIET cop we cannot (no claim_feed - the M7-19 policy is ours to deploy and an opponent may deploy it too), and a random walker. Conservative by construction: claims are not modelled on the capture side, so every same-cell ending still resolves - the quiet cop is modelled as strong as a loud one, which understates our survival rather than flattering it. Seeds 401..432 (32, not M7-16's 16): the cop-side M7-20 run proved 16 seeds cannot resolve this pool. Gate seeds 1..32 stay disjoint. Weights land in a SEPARATE artifact and deploy only via config review.
